R7AA-moose-walk-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 30 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 3.7 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), 40 m NE: browse.
Moose winter range u-7-022 unit 11 (official), right here. Counts from November.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.
Private land 100 m NW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 70 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.04804, -123.18339, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 1.9 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 17 m, about 41 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-15, Region 7A. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 10 to Nov 5 and more rows (synopsis page 57, 99%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-moose-walk-0004.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-15: about 6,166 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.67 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
